target_customer: Frontier AI labs buying RL environments, benchmarks and expert-led evaluations for knowledge work, starting with financial services
problem: Computer-use agents need realistic sandboxes and graded tasks to learn knowledge work such as private equity due diligence. Halluminate builds the environments and benchmarks.
business_model: Data and RL environment sales to AI labs; the YC page claims a mid-eight-figure revenue run rate, profitable (company claim)
product_category: RL environments and benchmarks for knowledge work

founders.name: Jerry Wu
prior_employers: Capital One Labs (led product and research, launched an early banking AI agent, three patents)

founders.name: Wyatt Marshall
prior_employers: Two early-stage NYC startups (data and software engineering)

competitors.name: Mechanize
competitors.what: Builds high-fidelity RL environments, starting with coding

technical_complexity.rationale: Building realistic simulated sites and expert-written benchmarks takes broad engineering and finance domain input but not new research.

defensibility.rationale: Anonymized real transaction data and a practitioner expert network are hard to copy, but labs and larger data vendors compete for the same work.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: A 2026 landscape piece reported these firms added environments to their labeling businesses.

market_need_then: TechCrunch reported on 2025-09-16 that labs were seeking RL environments to train agents, and the YC page says finance practitioners wrote the benchmark problems, indicating strong buyer demand.

branding.community_and_virality: The Westworld benchmark was covered by Fortune and discussed on Hacker News (Launch HN).

brand_strength.rationale: A coined name with no sourced origin. Benchmark coverage built recognition, but no evidence of brand-led growth.

pivots.from: Evaluation and benchmarking infrastructure for browser agents
pivots.to: Building post-training RL environments for frontier labs
pivots.why: Per a profile summary, the hardest and most valuable work was building high-quality environments. Exact month not given.

outcome_analysis: Halluminate shifted in 2025 from agent evaluation to RL environments just as labs began buying them, and claimed a mid-eight-figure revenue run rate with five people while profitable. It raised a $30M Series A in October 2026 led by Oak HC/FT, per Fortune and another outlet, bringing reported total funding to $38.5M. Success rests on timing, a pivot and finance expert data.
notes: Series A: seen in the Fortune and Pulse 2.0 headlines and URLs and in the company site link, but the article bodies were not opened, so details come from search summaries. The $38.5M total implies about $8.5M earlier funding, which is unreconciled. Revenue run rate and customer claims are from the company or an interview summary.
